topic: how AI picks its next word
title: Next word
subtitle: how AI picks it
facts: Language models such as ChatGPT and Claude split text into tokens: whole words or pieces of words.
The model runs the tokens through many layers and produces a score for every token in its vocabulary as the possible next one.
Those scores become probabilities. The model picks one, often the most likely, with some randomness (sampling), then adds it and repeats, one token at a time.
The bar values in the rank scene are illustrative and tagged as an example, not measured from a real model.
